newsitem.title: JAPAN: Prosecutors raid Nomura, JAFCO - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors raid Nomura, JAFCO - Jiji.

text.p: Tokyo prosecutors raided Nomura Securities Co Ltd and its affiliated finance firm Japan Associated Finance Co Ltd on Friday to search for evidence of suspected illegal payoffs, Jiji news agency reported.
A spokesman for Nomura said he could not immediately confirm the report. A spokesman for Japan Associated Finance (JAFCO) was not immediately available.
On Thursday, prosecutors charged former Nomura president Hideo Sakamaki with making illegal payoffs to corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike.

They also served Sakamaki and two other former Nomura executives with new arrest warrants alleging they conspired to pay Koike 320 million yen around March 24, 1995, in exchange for a pledge by him to ensure the firm's June shareholders' meeting went smoothly.
Shares in JAFCO fell sharply on the over-the-counter market in Tokyo on Friday morning to 9,020 yen from their close of 9,180 yen on Thursday.
